target: scaffold.sh manifest — project type gates the factory tier; media/other scaffold nothing
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; jq -n --arg un "$(scaffold_manifest software-unattended | grep -c 'factory')" --arg iv "$(scaffold_manifest software-interviewed | grep -c 'factory')" --arg md "$(scaffold_manifest media | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" --arg core "$(scaffold_manifest software-interviewed | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" '{unattended_factory: $un, interviewed_factory: $iv, media_total: $md, interviewed_total: $core}'
